Maya (CSM): Heads-up: Monarch Retail health dropped 87->58 after last deploy. Renewal in 28 days. Starting save plan thread.
Jamal (Support Eng): Looking at logs — embeddings endpoint spike tied to KV cache thrash post-2026-03-10 deploy. Seeing OOM-ish evictions.
Priya (Solutions): Quick triage plan: 30-min enablement + config audit. If adoption doesn't rebound in 10 days, propose downgrade-swap mitigation instead of immediate concession.
Eli (AE): Pricing options to prepare: 3mo 20% off, or temporary 'Core' tier (feature-limited, preserved metadata) + migration support.
Maya (CSM): Outreach cadence draft: Day0 onboarding call, Day3 enablement session, Day7 health check, Day14 usage push + report. Owners: Maya (owner), Priya (enablement), Jamal (tech fix), Eli (commercial).
Onboarding Bot: Action created: enablement-session scheduled 2026-03-13 11:00 PT — Maya, Priya.
Jamal (Support Eng): I'll patch KV cache config (increase TTL, reduce eviction churn) and run a canary tonight. ETA ~6h.
Maya (CSM): Messaging to customer should be concise + actionable. Template: "We're seeing performance regressions; short call to fix config + 48h monitoring — we'll share wins." I'll send.
Priya (Solutions): Capture success gaps for the playbook: 1) No eval harness scheduled 2) Missing prefix caching 3) Cost visibility unclear 4) Onboarding didn't include 'mini-bootcamp'. Adding these to playbook notes.
Eli (AE): If customer still requests downgrade after 21 days, execute 'downgrade-swap' path: preserve dataset & keys, 2-week transition support, rollback SLA, and one free migration assist.
Maya (CSM): Logging decision points/outcomes in CRM. Also ask customer for feedback on docs that caused friction — want verbatim examples.
Jamal (Support Eng): Patch deployed to canary — early telemetry: 95p latency down 25%, token cost per call flat. Rolling to full if stable.
Maya (CSM): Great. Monitor daily. If usage remains >30% below baseline at Day10, escalate for concession approval.
Eli (AE): Acknowledge — I can approve up to 20% for 3 months; >20% needs manager sign-off. Ping me with usage snapshots.
Priya (Solutions): I'll prep 'mini bootcamp' (30–45m): 1) eval scripts/guides 2) caching config checklist 3) prompt engineering quick wins 4) monitoring dashboard links. Share by EOD.
Maya (CSM): Running the first call tomorrow. Post-call deliverables: summary email + next steps + playbook tag 'save-diversion-2026Q1' in CRM.
Eli (AE): Also flag for potential Dedicated upsell after stabilization — better economics if they stay.
Maya (CSM): Thanks team. Short term goal = stabilize usage and preserve renewal; medium = move to predictable Dedicated path if they expand. :thumbsup:
Onboarding Bot: Note: playbook tag applied to CRM: save-diversion-2026Q1.
